data.name: Khayree
data.gender_notes: Khayree is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'khayr', meaning 'good' or 'blessing'. In Islamic context, Khayree can be interpreted as 'the one who is given blessings'. This name carries a spiritual significance, implying the idea of God's blessings upon someone. The name Khayree carries the meaning “Free, Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khayree usually hope their child will grow to embody free, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a mature and virtuous person, often associated with spiritual growth and elevation.
data.etymology: Khayree belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Free, Generous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khayree total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
